result.summary: Found 1 issue: overlapping text in the delivery time/fee line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar.

issues.description: The text under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows '25-3' followed by overlapping '350mDelivery' text, indicating a rendering/layout collision between the delivery time and delivery fee text elements.
